subject: Final ranking & commitment letter for candidate: L5 IC vs L5 Manager discussion
messages:
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
From: KiteTalent <katie@kitetalent.io>
To: elliot.price@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Subject: Candidate packet: Jane Doe — senior infra engineering (L5)

Hi Elliot,

Following our onsite last week, Jane is our top pick for the senior infra role. She has strong systems design and distributed cache experience; hiring manager wants L5 IC or L5 Manager option (depends on scope). KiteTalent recommended a comp package in the $205k-$230k base range + target equity/bonus to match market.

Attached: candidate CV, interview matrix, salary reference from recruiter panel. Can you confirm whether we should propose an L5 IC offer or open the Manager title discussion? Hiring manager (Marcus) is leaning manager if we can justify scope (will own a cross-team infra initiative).

Thanks,
Katie
KiteTalent (sourcing partner)

Attachments: Jane_Doe_CV.pdf (pdf), interview-matrix-JD.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Date: 2027-04-01T11:03:00-07:00
From: elliot.price@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Candidate packet: Jane Doe — senior infra engineering (L5)

Team — quick thread to get a final ranking and commitment.

Summary:
- Candidate: Jane Doe (strong IC + leadership potential)
- Hiring manager: Marcus recommends Manager if scope includes owning cross-team infra reliability initiative (3 teams).
- Risk: Offering Manager title increases comp band and sets a manager hire precedent for this org slice.

Ask: Please reply with a single-line: APPROVE_MANAGER / APPROVE_IC / ASK_FOR_MORE_INFO. If APPROVE_MANAGER, include suggested base and equity (ballpark). We need to finalize commitment letter by Friday (2027-04-03).

Context: market comps point to $220k base midpoint for L5 Manager in SF; L5 IC midpoint is ~$205k. We've budgeted mid-to-high L5 for Q2. I attached the comp band snapshot and proposed offer terms.

Thanks — Elliot
Elliot Price
VP, Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Comp_Band_L4-L6_2027Q2.xlsx, Offer_Template_L5.pdf

Date: 2027-04-01T13:22:00-07:00
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: elliot.price@redwood.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Subject: RE: Candidate packet: Jane Doe — senior infra engineering (L5)

APPROVE_MANAGER — with conditions.

Notes:
- Marcus to provide a 1-paragraph scope doc that clearly lists cross-team ownership (must show direct reports not required, but influence across 3 squads + P&L considerations).
- Approve base up to $225k and equity at manager midpoint band + 25% (to close). No signing bonus unless candidate asks — reserve $15k sign-off for exceptional counter.
- Hiring manager must commit to a performance review at 6 months with clear success metrics.

If Marcus sends the scope doc today I'll sign-off on the commitment letter.

Laura Bennett
Head of Eng Ops
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-04-02T09:08:00-07:00
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, elliot.price@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Candidate packet: Jane Doe — senior infra engineering (L5)

Attaching the 1-paragraph scope and suggested milestones as requested.

Scope (excerpt): Jane will lead the reliability uplift for edge-caching and KV service, coordinate across Edge, Core infra, and Platform teams (~3 squads), and be accountable for latency P99 reduction and rollout of new KV sharding by Q4. Not a direct people manager initially; will build cross-team design authority.

Milestones (6 months):
- Technical rollout plan v1 with risk assessment (30 days)
- Completed performance benchmarks in staging (90 days)
- End-to-end rollout plan and initial canary (180 days)

Suggested comp: Base $222,500; Target equity: manager midpoint + 20%. Recommend no sign-on other than relocation stipend (if required).

Marcus
Director, Infra

Attachment: JD_scope_Jane_Doe_2027-04-02.docx

Date: 2027-04-03T10:17:00-07:00
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: elliot.price@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Subject: RE: Candidate packet: Jane Doe — senior infra engineering (L5)

APPROVE_MANAGER — I agree with Laura's conditions. Two small asks:
1) Add a "graduation" clause in the offer that says title can be revisited after 6 months based on delivery (to address IC vs Mgr perception).
2) Put a clear onboarding plan into the offer memo so compensation justification is traceable for audits.

Otherwise green to send.

Tessa Morgan
Chief People Officer

Date: 2027-04-03T16:40:00-07:00
From: elliot.price@redwood.com
To: jane.doe@example.com
Cc: katie@kitetalent.io, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Subject: Offer: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (L5 Manager) — Redwood Inference

Hi Jane,

Great speaking with you last week — we loved your systems experience and the way you approach cross-team coordination. After internal calibration wed like to extend an offer for the Senior Infrastructure Engineer role at Redwood (level: L5, title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer — Manager track).

Offer highlights (summary):
- Base salary: $222,500/year
- Equity: RSU grant at manager midpoint + 20% (details in attached offer letter)
- Bonus: target 12% annual
- Start date: flexible (typical 4–6 weeks)
- Manager track: role scoped to lead cross-team infra reliability program; initial hire is IC-with-leadership-influence and will be reviewed at 6 months for formal manager title transition if milestones met.

The formal commitment letter and offer PDF are attached. Please review and send any questions — we'd like to have your response by end of week.

Best,
Elliot Price
VP, Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Offer_Jane_Doe_2027-04-03.pdf, Comp_Band_L4-L6_2027Q2.xlsx
